"''A-2.|Kanan Jarrus and a Stormtrooper Commander|audio=IsThisSectionB17-AnInsideMan.flac|}} '''Section B-17''' was a location inside the [[Imperial Armory Complex|Imperial Factory]] on the [[planet]] [[Lothal]]. In [[2 BBY]], after the [[Spectres|rebel]] [[C1-series astromech droid|C1-series]] [[astromech droid]] [[C1-10P]] "Chopper" [[Infiltration of the Imperial Armory Complex|stole schematics]] for the [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter|TIE Defender]] from [[section A-2]], fellow rebels [[Kanan Jarrus]] and [[Ezra Bridger]] claimed to a [[Unidentified stormtrooper commander (Imperial Armory Complex)|stormtrooper commander]] that they were looking for section B-17. ==Description== Section B-17 was a section located in the [[Imperial Armory Complex|Imperial Factory]], a large [[factory]] based in the [[Imperial Complex (Lothal)|Imperial Complex]] of [[Capital City]] on the [[planet]]''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]'' [[Lothal]]. ==History== In [[2 BBY]],{{RebelsDate|310}} the [[Spectres]] [[Kanan Jarrus]], [[Ezra Bridger]], and their [[C1-series astromech droid|C1-series]] [[astromech droid]] [[C1-10P]], nicknamed "Chopper," disguised themselves as [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] personnel in order to [[Infiltration of the Imperial Armory Complex|infiltrate]] the factory's [[Section A-2|A-2 section]] and [[Thief|steal]] the schematics for the top secret [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter|TIE Defender]]. While Jarrus and Bridger stood in a hallway outside section A-2 awaiting Chopper's return, a [[Unidentified stormtrooper commander (Imperial Armory Complex)|stormtrooper commander]] and their [[troop]]s cornered the disguised [[Phoenix Cell|rebels]]. [[File:WereNewTransfers-AnInsideMan.png|thumb|right|300px|Stormtroopers approached the Spectres after they discredited the rebels' claim of guard duty.]] Unconvinced by the rebels' claim of guard duty, the [[stormtrooper]]s approached the rebels while Chopper exited A-2 with the Defender's schematics. Before leaving the area, Jarrus asked the [[Stormtrooper Commander]] if they were in section B-17. Informed by the [[trooper]] that they were in fact by section A-2, Bridger apologized to the [[commander]] and claimed they were new transfers. However, the [[corporal]] was not deterred and ordered their subordinates to pursue the disguised rebels as they attempted to escape the factory. ==Behind the scenes== Section B-17 was mentioned in "[[An Inside Man]]," the tenth episode in the [[Star Wars Rebels Season Three|third season]] of the animated television series ''[[Star Wars Rebels]]'', which premiered on [[December 3]], [[2016]].{{InsiderCite|174|Star Wars Rebels Season Three Episode Guide|''Star Wars Rebels'' Season Three Episode Guide}} ==Appearances== *{{Rebels|An Inside Man}} {{1stm}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} [[Category:Capital City locations]] [[Category:Galactic Empire locations]]
